strings.name: Lang Lang
strings.summary: Lang Lang trained in China before studying at the Curtis Institute. His 1999 substitution with the Chicago Symphony opened an international career. Touring, recordings and crossover performances widened classical audiences. He founded a music foundation, supported children’s education and became a UN Messenger of Peace, linking Chinese musicians, international orchestras and young learners.

strings.influence.rationale: Through classical piano, international touring and education projects, he expands audiences and advances Chinese musicians’ participation in global classical music.
